tools.name: roof_rafter_span_calculator

tools.name: stair_stringer_calculator

tools.name: roof_pitch_rafter_length_calculator

tools.name: sheathing_sheet_calculator

tools.name: lumber_board_foot_calculator

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_and_footing_size_calculator · Private data: stair_stringer_calculator · Public sink: deck_joist_and_beam_span_calculator, post_and_footing_size_calculator · Destructive: stair_stringer_calculator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_and_footing_size_calculator · Private data: stair_stringer_calculator · Public sink: deck_joist_and_beam_span_calculator, post_and_footing_size_calculator · Destructive: stair_stringer_calculator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
